rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=0.5, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.0003, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-10 ONE-KNOB CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: per-scan/warm-start grad_clip 1.0->0.5 (the gradient-norm clip on the shared Adam fit). ALL OTHER KNOBS held at the iter-7 WINNING baseline (lr=3e-4, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, unet_c=16, val_n=4, seed=42, outer_wall_s=1500). seed RESET 1337->42 so this isolates grad_clip alone vs the iter-7 winner (0.9562), not against iter-9's seed swap. FAILURE MODE (per-image U-Net N2I converged on Mayo's 2304-view substrate): iters 1-9 exhausted every standard lever -- (a) n_iter 400->800 marginal 0.9501->0.9508 (budget SATURATED, iters 1-2); (b) unet_c 16->32 DEAD on BOTH operating points (iter-3 lr1e-3 0.9508->0.9502; iter-8 anchored 0.9543 < winner); (c) per-scan lr LOCALIZED, 3e-4 bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 beats 1e-3@iter-1 0.9501 and 1e-4@iter-5 0.9479); (d) warm-start pretrain_epochs DIMINISHING (3->6 +0.0017 iter-6, 6->8 +0.0004 iter-7); (e) SEED ceiling-confirmation probe iter-9 (42->1337) landed 0.9549, within ~0.0013 of the 0.9562 winner -> CONFIRMS the ~0.956 per-image U-Net noise floor and that the iter-6/7 spread (0.9558-0.9562) is inside the run-to-run variance band. grad_clip is the ONE remaining UNTRIED axis: it has been hard-wired at 1.0 since iter-1 and never probed. HYPOTHESIS (clip-operating-point-is-inert): grad_clip is MANDATORY (the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows un-clipped, per campaign-state), but its VALUE has never been characterized. Tightening 1.0->0.5 makes each per-scan Adam step more conservative -- a regularization-adjacent change on the same per-scan fit whose lr lever already bracketed at 3e-4. EXPECTED OUTCOME: this is a ceiling-DOCUMENTATION probe, NOT a knob expected to climb. If val lands within ~+/-0.001 of 0.9562, it CONFIRMS the clip value is inert at the converged operating point (the fit is anchor/lr-limited, not clip-limited) -- documenting that grad_clip=1.0 was never silently capping headroom and the ~0.956 ceiling holds regardless of clip tightness. If val swings >0.001, it tells iters 11-20 that clip is a live (and previously unswept) operating-point knob worth a finer sweep. Either outcome is a clean ceiling read on the LAST untried axis. EXACTLY ONE knob changes (grad_clip 1.0->0.5); lr/pretrain/n_iter/unet_c/val_n/seed ALL held at the iter-7 winner. WALL <=15 min: identical step count to iter-7 (unet_c=16, n_iter=400, val_n=4) which ran ~792-909s; grad_clip is free; outer_wall_s=1500 caps it. grad_clip stays ON (>=0.5) -- the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows if clipping is disabled. Converging to the ~0.956 per-image ceiling toward iter-20. DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
